top_signals.title: Hong Kong Investigates IPO Rigging
top_signals.summary: The Securities and Futures Commission warned investment banks and other intermediaries against arrangements that may artificially inflate demand for initial public offerings. Minmin Low has more on "The Asia Trade." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US Army, Navy research labs team up to combat Arctic cold
top_signals.summary: As the Department of Defense eyes greater operability in the Arctic, it needs equipment that can operate in temps as low as -50 degrees Fahrenheit.
